name: Dacia Grayber

bio.statement: Her official legislative page has Grayber describing a career as a firefighter.
bio.excerpt: As a firefighter, I have spent my life serving the community, one call at a time.

bio.statement: Her official page describes House District 28 as parts of Southwest Portland, Garden Home, Hillsdale, Raleigh Hills and Beaverton.
bio.excerpt: Our house district is made up of parts of Southwest Portland, Garden Home, Hillsdale, Raleigh Hills, and Beaverton.

positions.statement: In her 2024 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Grayber said Oregon should protect its future through climate resilience.
positions.excerpt: Let's protect Oregon's future through climate resilience

positions.statement: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Grayber said communities suffering from addiction should be helped to heal.
positions.excerpt: Let's heal our communities suffering from addiction.

positions.statement: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Grayber said the state must work to elevate the lives of working families.
positions.excerpt: We must work relentlessly to elevate the lives of working families.

voting_record.statement: KGW reports Grayber is chief sponsor of House Bill 4113, on firefighter cancer protections.
voting_record.excerpt: Representative Dacia Grayber is chief sponsor of the bill.
